description: Behavior-preservation (golden-master) gate. Tier-2 (GPU): recovered per-frame pose vs fem.jts within tolerance; projected silhouette vs Labels within pixel threshold. Tolerance finalized from the one-time Qt5/GPU capture (fem_oracle.jtak).

compare_reference.tier1: CI headless CPU: DirectOptimizer converges on analytic cost (test/unit/test_direct_optimizer.cpp)
compare_reference.tier2: GPU (robust, appearance-based): project the implant (DRR) at the final optimized pose and compare the rendered silhouette to Labels/fem/ within a pixel-diff / IoU threshold. Pose-vs-fem.jts is informational only, because DIRECT numeric convergence is noisy.

settings.budget_note: Production cumulative caps from src/services/optimizer_settings.cpp defaults + Optimize(): trunk 20000, +2 branches 5000 each, +leaf 5000. The Tier-2 oracle run was reduced to a flat 3000 for run time and is NOT the production budget shape.

captured_baseline.notes: Direct comparative output of the current Qt5/GPU pipeline on Kneel_1. Matches fem.jts within tolerance (gaps below).

measured.note: Measured at the first Tier-2 oracle run (RTX 3090) via test/oracle/oracle_test.cpp.
measured.run_config: DIRECT_DILATION; budget 3000 (reduced from cumulative 20k/25k/30k/35k for run time); search range (12,12,15,15,15,15) around fem.jts frame 0; Canny 3/0/150; dilation 6; backface culling OFF (matches label generator Study2Grid)
measured.frame_label_mapping: 1024/2806.tif <-> Labels/fem/AT_K1_V1_0160_label_fem.tif (resolved empirically: start-pose render IoU==1.0; the binary label TIFFs use a bottom-left y-origin, so the oracle vertically flips the label)

tolerances.notes: The HARD Tier-2 gate is the rendered-silhouette-vs-Labels IoU (>0.85, a healthy margin below the observed 0.9936); per-px L1 (0.0207 < 0.021 informational) and pose-vs-fem.jts are informational, because DIRECT numeric convergence is noisy. The frame<->label correspondence is pinned empirically by a start-pose IoU == 1.0. Thresholds measured on the RTX 3090; other GPU hardware may vary slightly.
